Boosts engagement, less rote, more philosophy-like thinking."},"reasoning_summary":"Answers reflect a 19yo Italian student's casual, blunt (low agreeableness) disinterest in math favoring humanities/hobbies; basic explanations suit vocational level; moderate neuroticism shows mild anxiety; high openness embraces AI innovatively; youthful, gamer tone consistent with persona/mode."}
